g.text: The benchmark is dense on one workload and sparse everywhere else

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: how many results each chip carries on each workload. 55 of 112 chip-workload cells hold any submission at

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: all, which is why a like-for-like comparison is only possible on a couple of workloads and why llama2-70b-99 carries the

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows MLCommons' published MLPerf Inference rules

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: A blank cell means nothing was submitted, not that the chip cannot run the workload — submitting is voluntary and costly, and vendors

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: pick their battles. Of 451 results in the release, 356 are token throughput with an attributable accelerator count and reach these

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: charts; the rest are other units, unnamed accelerators, or one mixed-accelerator system. Every figure is a vendor-tuned submission to

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: the closed division, where the model and the accuracy target are fixed and the system is optimised hard for the benchmark. Production

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: serving runs below this, so these are ceilings rather than expected throughput.
